parole.significato: A king or high chief of the Tuaregs.
A Tuareg language spoken in Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso, and Nigeria.
parole.testo: From Tuareg ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵌⵈ. Probably derived from an older Berber language spoken in the Sahel.

parole.testo: Borrowed from Tuareg ⵜⵉⵛⵓⵎⴰⵔⴻⵏ (ticumaren), feminine plural of ⴰⵛⵓⵎⴰⵔ (acumar), itself borrowed from French chômeur (“unemployed person”).
